تبتدروا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِرُوا (tabtadirū) /tab.ta.di.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# تُبْتَدَرُوا (tubtadarū) /tub.ta.da.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
